definitions.pair: nondegenerate sign-aware cooccurring literal pair (a,b) with A=|a|, B=|b| and A!=B
definitions.P_ab: all clauses of F containing both selected literals a and b; these are replaced by the B2 OR-pair macro
definitions.aligned_one_sided_external_incidence: For every clause C outside P_ab: if C contains variable A then it contains a and not -a; if C contains variable B then it contains b and not -b. Thus external occurrences of A and B, if any, are aligned with the selected literal signs and never occur in the opposite polarity.
definitions.e: fresh extension variable introduced by apply_or_pair_v2
definitions.cap: N^2 in the frozen C025 v3 configuration

theorem.name: CAP_ADMISSIBLE_ALIGNED_ONE_SIDED_PAIR_GUARANTEES_V3_TWO_ELIMINATION_PLAN
theorem.statement: Let F be root-free. If a cooccurring pair (a,b) satisfies aligned_one_sided_external_incidence and its exact B2 macro M fits the frozen cap, then the frozen v3 search has an exact two-pivot plan eliminating A=|a| and B=|b|. Both eliminate_var_capped calls stay within the same raw cap before optional canonical/subsumption compression, and the final root-free progress potential strictly decreases.
proof: After B2 replacement, every external A occurrence is in a clause (a OR R); there is no external -a clause. The only -a clause is D_A=(-e OR -a), while D_plus=(e OR a OR b) is on the a side.

Eliminating A therefore has no external-by-external Cartesian product: each external (a OR R) pairs only with D_A and resolves to (-e OR R), which has exactly the same clause-unit cost 1+|C| as its parent external clause because e is fresh. D_plus paired with D_A yields a tautology containing both e and -e and is discarded.

The raw elimination accumulator starts from all A-free retained clauses. Removing the external A clauses, D_A and D_plus and then re-adding at most one same-size resolvent for each external A clause gives raw_units_after_A <= state_units(M)-units(D_A)-units(D_plus)=state_units(M)-3-4=state_units(M)-7. Duplicate or tautological resolvents can only lower this value.

The aligned condition also forbids any B occurrence inside an external A clause: a clause outside P_ab cannot contain both selected literals a and b, and opposite-sign B is forbidden. Hence the new (-e OR R) resolvents created by eliminating A contain no B.
After eliminating A, every remaining B occurrence outside D_B is therefore an original external clause (b OR S), with no external -b clause. The only -b clause is D_B=(-e OR -b).

Eliminating B is again one-sided: each (b OR S) resolves with D_B to (-e OR S), preserving that clause's unit cost. Therefore raw_units_after_B <= state_units(after_A)-units(D_B) <= state_units(M)-10.

Because both raw bounds are <= state_units(M), macro cap admission alone implies both exact eliminations remain under cap even though eliminate_var_capped charges raw_units before subsumption compression.

The macro introduces at most the fresh variable e and the two distinct pre-macro variables A and B are eliminated. Thus final live-variable count is at most v_before-1. In root-free mode frozen Phi equals live-variable count, so progress is strict.

v3 enumerates all cooccurring literal pairs and ordered pairs of distinct pre-macro live pivots. Therefore it eventually inspects this pair and a valid A/B pivot order; exact replay, not heuristic preference, admits the plan.

raw_budget_bounds.consequence: If state_units(M)<=N^2, neither elimination can hit RAW_CAP_EXCEEDED in this corridor.

theorem.strict_generalization: Closed-pair rescue is the zero-external-incidence special case. This theorem allows arbitrarily many external A/B clauses and arbitrary clause widths, provided those external incidences are aligned and one-sided as defined.

remaining_gap.name: MIXED_SIGN_EXTERNAL_BUCKET_PRODUCT
remaining_gap.description: A surviving cap-admissible pair outside this corridor must expose opposite-sign external incidence for at least one selected variable. Then positive/negative external buckets can cross-product under elimination and require a quantitative bucket-mass bound or another exact representation.
remaining_gap.next_exact_target: Derive a sufficient raw-cap inequality for mixed-sign external incidence using positive/negative bucket counts and tail-literal masses, then propagate the first elimination's effect into the second pivot without hiding quadratic work.
